entries.title: Psalms 13:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou forget me for ever? How long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

entries.title: Psalms 13:2
segments: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart all the day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

entries.title: Psalms 13:3
segments: Consider [and] answer me, O Jehovah my God: Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the [sleep of] death;

entries.title: Psalms 13:4
segments: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; [Lest] mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.

entries.title: Psalms 13:5
segments: But I have trusted in thy lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 13:6
segments: I will sing unto Jehovah, Because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
